'''Clue scroll (easy)''' is an [[emote clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (easy)|easy]] [[Treasure Trails]].

The items can be stored in a [[STASH]] bush south-west of the parrot cage. It requires 27 [[Construction]], a [[hammer]], [[saw]], 2 [[plank]]s and 10 [[nails]] to build. Building the STASH rewards the player with 150 Construction experience.
